title: Limited Attention and the Earnings Announcement Returns of Past Stock Market Winners
one_line: Stocks with the highest prior 12-month returns earn positive abnormal returns in the days before their earnings announcements and negative returns after — consistent with attention-driven individual buying.

findings.statement: Pre-announcement run-up and post-announcement reversal for top past winners.

reported_results.headline: Stocks with the highest prior 12-month returns earn positive abnormal returns in the days before their earnings announcements and negative returns after — consistent with attention-driven individual buying.

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
